parameters.description: Tooth centered in the 30 deg aperture.

provenance.T_run_units: Native units returned by compute_dynamic_Trun; no conversion applied.

dynamic_Trun_diagnostics.equation: Sigma = 0.5/d_eff_um; T_ideal = -ln(target_suppression)/(2*Sigma); T_run = clip(safety_factor*T_ideal, min_floor, max_ceil)
dynamic_Trun_diagnostics.units: d_eff_um: micrometres; T_run: normalized Wick-damping time

provenance.regime_note: Expected regimes are pilot hypotheses, not simulation results.

solver_parameters.physics_qualification: Panel-collocation scalar Yukawa BEM with dielectric-weighted channels; not an exact vector electromagnetic FSC/PMCHWT calculation. Use SCUFF-EM for electromagnetic results.
solver_parameters.channel_weights: normal-incidence TM and TE Fresnel amplitudes
solver_parameters.symmetry_method: sum of four cyclic Fourier-block traces
solver_parameters.off_diagonal_quadrature: panel centroid with finite-panel distance sqrt(distance^2 + (A_target + A_source)/(8*pi))
solver_parameters.normal_derivatives: analytic finite-panel-regularized kernel derivatives; diagnostics only
solver_parameters.diagnostic_decomposition: partition of translation derivative by rotor panel; not an independently observable Maxwell-stress face force

raw_solver_result.force_direction: z; negative means attraction toward stator
raw_solver_result.physics_qualification: Panel-collocation scalar Yukawa BEM with dielectric-weighted channels; not an exact vector electromagnetic FSC/PMCHWT calculation. Use SCUFF-EM for electromagnetic results.
raw_solver_result.convergence_note: No resolution/frequency convergence study has been performed.

memory_measurement_source: solver-estimated dense allocation bytes converted to GiB
